I figured it was time to replace them. Original equipment replacements were pricey. There was a slight difference from the originals in design. These replacements had an extra turn in the coils. But I checked the measurements and took a chance they'd work.

And they DO work. They fit and look better than the original coils. The extra turn in the coils seems to make them a little slower to get to red hot, but they're really efficient at heating and are no slower to get pots and pans to cooking temperature than the original coils.

Check the Start Device before taking apart the fridge looking for other issues. It's easy to check, diagnose and an easy fix. - After You Tubing the problems I ordered the part. BTW if all the fans in your fridge work and it doesn't get cold i.e. the compressor doesn't work, this part is probably the solution. Search YouTube for the videos but the most clear symptom of the start device not working is all the other fans work, and there are a bunch of fans in a fridge, but the fridge doesn't get cold. Once you remove the start device from the side of the compressor and find it either rattles or little pieces of electrical waste fall out of it when you shake it. This kit takes care of everything you will most likely need. The directions are clear and easy to follow and there are lots of videos to watch as well. Buy it from the Warehouse and save a few bucks. IN any event before you start taking apart the fridge looking for problems check the start device on the side of the compressor. It's easy to check and seems to be the number one problem for a warm freezer and fridge.
